column1: # Every RPC of the public contract and how a client authenticates it:
# `public` when the contract marks the method `(polyester.api.public) = true`,
# so the SDK sends it unsigned and a client without an API key can call it;
# `signed` otherwise: it needs credentials, and the SDK signs the ones it
# wraps with the API key and refuses them without one before sending. The
# list follows the contract this SDK is built on (`manifest.json`); regenerate
# it with the contract. Guard tests read the generated Connect clients
# and the service wrappers: they fail when the contract gains or loses an RPC
# not reflected here, when a wrapper signs a `public` RPC or sends a `signed`
# one unsigned, and when a keyless client cannot send every public read.
